blocks.en: Invoked at the end of every other playbook.
blocks.zh: 在其他每个执行规程结束时调用。

blocks.en: **Worktree.** Work from a git worktree off main. Subagents inherit it. Multiple `Task` calls on the same branch each get their own worktree, or `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/<branch>` between them. Dirty branch with unrelated work: patch out, fresh worktree, apply. Snarled worktree: reset from main, redo minimally.
blocks.zh: **Worktree。**从 main 创建 Git worktree 并在其中工作，subagent 继承它。同一分支上的多次 `Task` 调用各用自己的 worktree，或在调用间执行 `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/<branch>`。分支有无关未提交工作时，先导出补丁、创建全新 worktree、应用补丁。worktree 混乱时，从 main 重置，只重做最小改动。

blocks.en: **Commits.** Commit liberally. Rebase into small, ordered commits before opening PRs. Each commit is a future PR: landable, ordered to tell the story. Amend when the fix belongs in a just-made commit. New commit when separable. Commit bodies don't restate the subject.
blocks.zh: **提交。**经常提交。创建 PR 前 rebase 为小而有序的提交。每次提交都是未来的一个 PR：可合入，顺序能说明改动逻辑。修复属于刚做的提交时用 amend；可独立分开时新建提交。

blocks.en: **PRs.** Run `/deslop` from `cursor-team-kit` over the diff before commit and `/no-comments` before review. Write every PR title, description, and commit body with `/technical-writing` (every layer except Diátaxis, and apply the STE vocabulary rules: one word per action, keep articles, a plain verb over `-ing` where one works), then apply `/unslop`.
blocks.zh: **PR。**提交前，对 diff 运行 `cursor-team-kit` 的 `/deslop`。评审前运行 `/no-comments`。每个 PR 标题、描述和提交正文先用 `/technical-writing` 撰写，再用 `/unslop` 清理。应用 technical-writing 除 Diátaxis 外的每一层。每个动作使用一个词，保留冠词，普通动词够用时避免 `-ing` 形式。

blocks.en: **Titles.** Conventional Commits `type(scope): subject`, no trailing period. Type such as `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`, or `perf`. Scope is the area, such as `pstack` or `poteto-mode`. Subject is short, imperative, and names a real symbol when one carries the change, for example `fix(pstack): retarget opening-a-pr babysit trigger`.
blocks.zh: **标题。**采用 Conventional Commits 格式 `type(scope): subject`。类型使用 `feat`、`fix`、`docs`、`refactor`、`test`、`chore` 或 `perf`。作用域采用改动区域，例如 `pstack` 或 `poteto-mode`。主题简短，并用祈使语气。改动围绕真实符号时，点名该符号。例如 `fix(pstack): retarget opening-a-pr babysit trigger`。末尾不加句号。

blocks.en: **Descriptions.** The PR body is a one-minute briefing, not a lab notebook, for a reviewer who has the diff. It says why the change exists, what it leaves out, what it could break, and how you proved it works. Write short, simple sentences with few identifiers, no walls of text. The body becomes the squash commit body, so keep that commit under about 40 lines. Use `##` headings, not bold lead-ins, in this order, and drop a section with nothing to say:
blocks.zh: **描述。** PR 正文面向已看到差异的审查者，是一分钟简报，不是实验笔记。说明改动为何存在、排除什么、可能破坏什么，以及如何证明有效。使用简短句子和少量标识符，避免大段文字。正文会成为 squash 提交正文，因此控制在约 40 行以内。按下列顺序使用 `##` 标题，不用加粗行首；没有内容的章节删去：

blocks.en:
- `## Why`: the problem and approach, 1–3 short sentences. No SHAs, rebase genealogy, or "based on main" preamble.
- `## What changed`: 1–3 short bullets. Name a real symbol or path only when it carries the change. Name both sides of a rename or retarget.
- `## Scope`: always. 1–3 short items on what it covers and what it deliberately leaves out (a follow-up, a known gap). No symbols, paths, or file-by-file essay.
- `## Tradeoffs`: only rejected alternatives a reviewer would otherwise ask about. Skip when there was no real choice.
- `## Blast Radius`: 1–2 sentences on who or what it touches and why that is safe or risky. If main is red, state the cost of leaving it red.
- `## Verification`: 1–3 bullets, each a real run path and its outcome. Perf: one primary number with its unit, `before → after`, and a link to the arena or swarm directory for the rest. No sample-size methodology, swarm recitals, or metric tables.
blocks.zh:
- `## Why`。用一至三句短文说明问题和方法。不列 SHA 或 rebase 历史，不加“基于 main”的前言。
- `## What changed`。列一至三个简短条目。仅当真实符号或路径承载该改动时才写出它。重命名或改目标时，说明前后两端。
- `## Scope`。始终说明 PR 覆盖什么，以及有意不包含什么，例如相关后续工作或已知缺口。用一至三个简短条目，不列符号或路径，也不要逐文件长篇叙述。
- `## Tradeoffs`。只列出评审者否则会追问的被否决方案。没有真实选择时省略本节。
- `## Blast Radius`。用一至两句话说明受影响的人或事，以及改动安全或有风险的原因。main 检查失败时，说明让它持续失败的成本。
- `## Verification`。列一至三个条目，每条说明实际运行路径及结果。性能改动报告一个带单位的主要指标，采用 `before → after`（改动前 → 改动后）形式。其余证据链接到 arena 或 swarm 目录。不要包含样本量方法论、swarm 运行细节复述或指标表。

blocks.en: After the sections, attach videos or screenshots when they prove a claim. Full SHAs, swarm or arena lane recitals, lever-correction essays, file-by-file checklists, and "CLEAN" verdicts go in a linked artifact, not the body.
blocks.zh: 这些章节后，仅在视频或截图能证明主张时附上它们。不要粘贴完整 SHA、swarm 或 arena 各任务过程、关于工具修正的长篇说明、逐文件检查表或“CLEAN”结论；将这些放在链接的产物中。提交正文不要复述主题。

blocks.en: **Forge.** Resolve the forge before the first PR operation and keep that choice for create, edit, view, watch, and merge. GitHub CLI (`gh`) is the default. If `command -v origin` succeeds and Origin can resolve the repository, prefer `origin pr ...`. If Origin is absent or cannot resolve the repository, stay on `gh` and record the fallback. Do not require Graphite (`gt`).
blocks.zh: **代码托管平台。**首次 PR 操作前确定操作工具，并在创建、编辑、查看、监控和合并时保持一致。默认使用 GitHub CLI（`gh`）。若 `command -v origin` 成功且 Origin 能解析仓库，优先使用 `origin pr ...`。若 Origin 不存在或无法解析仓库，就继续使用 `gh`，并记录回退。不要求安装 Graphite（`gt`）。

blocks.en: **Built-in PR tool.** When the run provides a built-in PR tool, create, edit, retarget, and mark ready through it, never through a forge CLI. A CLI-made PR misses what the tool tracks. Use the resolved forge for everything the tool does not cover, and for every PR operation when the run has no such tool.
blocks.zh: **内置 PR 工具。** 当运行环境提供了内置 PR 工具时，所有创建、编辑、重设 base 和标记就绪的操作均通过该工具完成，绝不要通过代码托管平台 CLI。工具自带的说明会指导具体用法。使用 CLI 创建的 PR 会丢失工具所跟踪的信息，例如后续运行可以编辑的描述内容。对于该工具未覆盖的操作，以及运行环境没有该工具时，使用解析出的代码托管平台处理所有 PR 操作。

blocks.en: **Size and stacks.** Prefer five narrow PRs to one large PR. A stack is a base-branch chain. The root PR targets trunk. Each child branch rebases onto its parent's exact tip and its PR targets the parent branch. As a parent merges, move its child onto trunk per `playbooks/shipping.md` step 4. Without a built-in PR tool, per the resolved forge, create a child with `origin pr create --status open --base <parent-branch>` or `gh pr create --base <parent-branch>`, and retarget one with `origin pr edit <pr> --base <parent-branch>` or `gh pr edit <pr> --base <parent-branch>`. Branch from trunk only for independent work. Rebase on trunk before substantial stack work.
blocks.zh: **规模与堆栈。** 优先五个小 PR，而非一个大 PR。堆栈是一条基分支链：根 PR 指向主干，子分支 rebase 到父分支精确头提交，PR 指向父分支。父 PR 合并后，按 `playbooks/shipping.md` 步骤 4 将子 PR 移到主干。没有内置 PR 工具时，按所选平台用 `origin pr create --status open --base <parent-branch>` 或 `gh pr create --base <parent-branch>` 创建子 PR，用 `origin pr edit <pr> --base <parent-branch>` 或 `gh pr edit <pr> --base <parent-branch>` 改目标。仅独立工作从主干分支；较大堆栈工作开始前先 rebase 主干。

blocks.en: **Readiness.** Open every PR ready, never as a draft. A built-in PR tool can default to draft, so set `draft: false` on every creation call through it. With Origin, pass `--status open`. With `gh`, omit `--draft`. If a PR still opens as a draft, mark it ready through the PR tool, or run `origin pr ready <number>` or `gh pr ready <number>` according to the resolved forge. Run `origin pr view <number>` or `gh pr view <number>` before you refer to PR status.
blocks.zh: **就绪状态。**每个 PR 都以可评审状态创建，绝不作为草稿。内置 PR 工具可能默认建草稿，因此通过其创建时每次调用均须传入 `draft: false`。Origin 传 `--status open`；`gh` 不传 `--draft`。如果仍创建为草稿，通过 PR 工具标记为就绪，或按已选工具运行 `origin pr ready <number>` 或 `gh pr ready <number>`。提到 PR 状态前，先运行 `origin pr view <number>` 或 `gh pr view <number>`。

blocks.en: **Babysit.** Opening a PR does not start a babysit. Post the URL and keep building. Finish the phase or stack first. Run a separate babysit pass only when the user asks for one after the whole stack exists. A babysit for each new PR stalls the build and spends checks on commits later waves restart. Push back when feedback drifts from intent.
blocks.zh: **跟进合并。**创建 PR 不会自动启动跟进流程。贴出 URL 后继续构建，先完成整个阶段或 PR 栈。只有整个栈已存在、用户随后明确要求时，才单独执行一次跟进。每建一个 PR 就跟进会拖慢构建，并浪费检查：后续工作还会让这些提交的检查重新运行。反馈偏离意图时，应提出异议。

blocks.en: A subagent that opens a PR runs `/deslop` and `/no-comments`, and posts the URL. It returns to the parent without babysitting, unless it is an Autopilot-full or Autopilot-stack owner. That owner's brief assigns the babysit loop and is the ask `playbooks/babysit.md` waits for. The owner starts the loop after its code-ready report, reports merge-ready, and is exempt from the rules here and in `playbooks/babysit.md` that hold babysitting until a whole stack is built.
blocks.zh: 打开 PR 的子代理先运行 `/deslop` 和 `/no-comments`，报告 URL 后返回父代理，不自行 babysit，Autopilot-full 或 Autopilot-stack 负责人除外。其简报已分配 babysit 循环，满足 `playbooks/babysit.md` 等待明确请求的要求。负责人在 code-ready 报告后开始循环，之后报告 merge-ready，不受此处及 babysit 剧本中“等整个堆栈完成才跟进”的规则限制。
